stops.title: Royal Rumble
blurb: January, and the year opens with thirty bodies and one way out: over the top rope.
Whoever is left standing gets the road to WrestleMania.

stops.title: WrestleMania
blurb: The biggest night of the spring is headlined by four men, not two.
Eliminations decide who walks out of the four-way with the gold.

stops.title: Backlash
blurb: Four weeks later the fallout arrives: one on one, nobody to hide behind.
Settle in the ring what WrestleMania left unfinished.

stops.title: King of the Ring
blurb: June brings the crown and the throne, and a main event fought in teams.
Watch your partner's back and keep your eyes on the title.

stops.title: SummerSlam
blurb: The end of summer, and three wrestlers share one ring and one prize.
One fall settles it, and it doesn't matter whose shoulders hit the mat.
